say:13:1221212010:1.source_cn: 我决定了！我要去拜一位真正的占卜者为师，深入研究占卜学。

say:14:1221212011:1.text: To be worthy of Merlin's blessing, I vow to become a true diviner one day!
say:14:1221212011:1.source_cn: 有了梅林的庇佑，我一定会成为真正的占卜大师的！
say:14:1221212011:1.male: To be worthy of Merlin's blessing, I vow to become a true diviner one day!
say:14:1221212011:1.female: To be worthy of Merlin's blessing, I vow to become a true diviner one day!

say:15:1221212012:1.text: Thanks for helping me! I have a feeling our paths will cross again in the future!
say:15:1221212012:1.source_cn: 感谢你们的帮助，再见啦！我有预感，我们以后还会再见的！

choice:11:0:1.text: That might not be the case...
choice:11:0:1.male: That might not be the case...
choice:11:0:1.female: That might not be the case...

choice:3:0:1.text: It says you aren't cut out for this.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 命运说你不适合这一行
choice:3:0:1.male: It says you aren't cut out for this.
choice:3:0:1.female: It says you aren't cut out for this.

say:2:1221204001:1.text: Let me see. Hmm... The main star of your destiny shines brightly, but its light isn't glaring. There are quite a lot of companion stars surrounding it.
say:2:1221204001:1.source_cn: 我看看，嗯……你的命运主星很明亮，光芒耀眼但不刺目，周...
say:2:1221204001:1.male: Let me see. Hmm... The main star of your destiny shines brightly, but its light isn't glaring. There are quite a lot of companion stars surrounding it.
say:2:1221204001:1.female: Let me see. Hmm... The main star of your destiny shines brightly, but its light isn't glaring. There are quite a lot of companion stars surrounding it.

say:3:1221204002:1.text: You must be an outstanding and charismatic person who always takes on the role of a leader within a team.
say:3:1221204002:1.source_cn: 你一定是位耀眼、出众、有个人魅力的人，总是扮演团队中的...
say:3:1221204002:1.male: You must be an outstanding and charismatic person who always takes on the role of a leader within a team.
say:3:1221204002:1.female: You must be an outstanding and charismatic person who always takes on the role of a leader within a team.

say:4:1221204003:1.text: That's spot-on! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is exactly like that!
say:4:1221204003:1.male: That's spot-on! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is exactly like that!
say:4:1221204003:1.female: That's spot-on! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is exactly like that!

say:5:1221204004:1.text: See? My interpretation is very accurate!
say:5:1221204004:1.source_cn: 瞧，我对启示的解读是非常准确的！

say:6:1221204005:1.text: Let me see if there's more... Your body and soul are in perfect harmony. You are quick-witted, physically strong, and have an excellent memory!
say:6:1221204005:1.source_cn: 让我再看看……你的身与灵完美契合，思维缜密、头脑灵活，...
say:6:1221204005:1.male: Let me see if there's more... Your body and soul are in perfect harmony. You are quick-witted, physically strong, and have an excellent memory!
say:6:1221204005:1.female: Let me see if there's more... Your body and soul are in perfect harmony. You are quick-witted, physically strong, and have an excellent memory!

say:7:1221204006:1.text: That's quite true as well... Wait, excellent... memory?
say:7:1221204006:1.source_cn: 也没错……呃，等等，出色的……记忆力？

say:8:1221204007:1.text: ...Ahem, maybe "excellent" is an overstatement... Don't be too particular about it.
say:8:1221204007:1.source_cn: ……咳，出色的，可能也没那么出色，但总体上来说是不错的...

say:9:1221204008:1.text: Ah! Look, the constellation representing your relationship is twinkling! It flickers on and off, pulsating like a heartbeat...
say:9:1221204008:1.source_cn: 啊！瞧，星盘上代表情感的星座在闪烁！时亮时暗，却像心跳...

say:11:1221204010:1.text: It means... you'll soon meet your ideal partner and begin a sweet romantic relationship...
say:11:1221204010:1.source_cn: 这代表——你最近会碰到自己的理想之人，陷入爱情的甜蜜烦...
say:11:1221204010:1.male: It means... you'll soon meet your ideal partner and begin a sweet romantic relationship...
say:11:1221204010:1.female: It means... you'll soon meet your ideal partner and begin a sweet romantic relationship...

say:14:1221204012:1.text: Amazing, right? That's the beauty of divination! It doesn't cost much to get a accurate interpretation of your destiny.
say:14:1221204012:1.source_cn: 很震惊吧？这就是占卜的魅力！只需花费少量金钱，我就会为...

say:15:1221204013:1.text: I learned to harness my ability under the guidance of a powerful individual.
say:15:1221204013:1.source_cn: 要知道，我解读命运的能力，可是来自于一位“伟大存在”的启示。

say:17:1221204015:1.text: It was the great Merlin! The legendary mage who founded the lost art of divination!
say:17:1221204015:1.source_cn: 是伟大的梅林！那位传奇的魔法师，占卜的创始者！
say:17:1221204015:1.male: It was the great Merlin! The legendary mage who founded the lost art of divination!
say:17:1221204015:1.female: It was the great Merlin! The legendary mage who founded the lost art of divination!

say:18:1221204016:1.text: What? Merlin? How's that possible? Merlin is...
say:18:1221204016:1.source_cn: 什么？梅林？怎么可能！梅林可是——
say:18:1221204016:1.male: What? Merlin? How's that possible? Merlin is...
say:18:1221204016:1.female: What? Merlin? How's that possible? Merlin is...

say:19:1221204017:0.text: There! That's the one! Don't let her get away!
say:19:1221204017:0.source_cn: 在那里，就是那个女人！别让她跑了！！

say:20:1221204018:1.text: Oops! I... I have to go!

narration:26:12021221:0.text: Selina suddenly turns and flees. Several residents, hot on her trail, run past you.
narration:26:12021221:0.source_cn: 赛琳娜突然转身逃跑了。随后有几位居民紧追着她，也从你们...
